name: eTurns
description_en:
eTurns TrackStock manages replenishment of consumable stock at the point of use, including customer-owned and consigned inventory. It supports barcode/QR-based work and offers optional electronic labels, RFID and weight-based SensorBins.

This is a stockroom and service-vehicle workflow rather than primarily an ecommerce storefront. A useful evaluation follows consumption into replenishment and, where relevant, distributor billing.
description_zh:
eTurns TrackStock 管理使用现场的耗材补货，包括客户自有和寄售库存。它支持条码或二维码作业，并提供电子标签、RFID 及称重式 SensorBins 等选项。

其核心是库房与服务车辆流程，而非电商店铺。评估应从消耗跟踪到补货，并在适用时核对经销商开票。

core_features.explanation_en: TrackStock uses counts or usage with min/max settings to initiate replenishment.
core_features.explanation_zh: TrackStock 结合盘点或消耗及库存上下限设置发起补货。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage describes parts/labor work orders, photos/signatures, transfers, returns and shared consignment reconciliation.
core_features.explanation_zh: Manage 描述含零件与工时的工单、照片签名、转移、退货及寄售共用核对记录。

en: Test a technician’s withdrawal and replenishment

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Test a technician’s withdrawal and replenishment
sections.en: Set item identifiers, supplier relationships, locations and min/max values, then record a part used on a service job. Compare the replenishment request with remaining stock and the supplier’s expected delivery. Manage can capture work-order parts/labor, photos and signatures; custom fields can tag project phases or locations. Confirm the relevant plan before designing around these fields.
sections.zh: 设置商品标识、供应商关系、地点和库存上下限，再记录维修任务领用零件。将补货请求与余量和预期到货比较。Manage 可记录工单零件、工时、照片与签名，自定义字段可标记项目阶段或地点；设计流程前应确认所属方案。

sections.title_en: Agree consignment reconciliation and billing triggers
sections.title_zh: 约定寄售核对及开票触发点
sections.en: The Manage page describes a shared record for end user and distributor and invoicing on replenishment or consumption. These are alternative commercial arrangements to establish with the distributor, not automatic ownership rules. Include a returned part and an erroneous withdrawal in the trial to check how both sides reconcile usage.
sections.zh: Manage 页面描述终端客户与经销商共享记录，以及按补货或消耗开票。这些是需与经销商约定的不同商务安排，不是自动货权规则。试用应包含退回零件和错误领用，检查双方如何核对消耗。

sections.title_en: Count stockrooms and vehicles, not just users
sections.title_zh: 按库房和车辆核算费用
sections.en: Published stockroom monthly equivalents are $40/$100/$249/$399 for Replenish/Manage Lite/Manage/Optimize, billed semi-annually. Vehicle pricing explicitly shows $40 for Replenish and $70 for Manage; blank vehicle-tier amounts should not be filled by inference. Hardware is additional: the FAQ gives approximately $96 per item for SensorBins and variable RFID costs. Optional phone support and added features are separate charges.
sections.zh: Replenish/Manage Lite/Manage/Optimize 的库房月均价为 $40/$100/$249/$399，每半年结算。车辆价格明确显示 Replenish $40、Manage $70，其他空白金额不能推测。硬件另计：FAQ 给出 SensorBins 约每商品 $96，RFID 按场景变化。可选电话支持和附加功能另收费。

sections.title_en: Choose automation after measuring actual consumption
sections.title_zh: 测量实际消耗后选择自动化
sections.en: The official site offers a 30-day trial with setup, training and phone support. Stockroom, MRO, distributor and service-truck teams can test scan-based use before buying sensor equipment. Confirm labeling, network coverage, replenishment approvals and sensor calibration responsibilities. Hardware reliability, offline behavior and financial reconciliation were not exercised.
sections.zh: 官网提供含设置、培训和电话支持的 30 天试用。库房、MRO、经销商及服务车团队可在购入传感设备前测试扫码使用。需明确标签、网络覆盖、补货审批和传感器校准责任。硬件可靠性、离线行为与财务核对尚未实际测试。
